watches.name: Gentlemen's Classic: Wonky Panda
watches.description: The Gentlemen’s Collection: Wonky Panda A twist on a modern classic. The Wonky Panda brings together refined British design and the precision of a Japanese automatic movement, showcased through a captivating open-heart dial. Designed for gentlemen who appreciate mechanical artistry, this timepiece balances technical intrigue with understated elegance. Inspired by the iconic “panda” dial, the Wonky Panda features a crisp off-white guilloché main dial, contrasted by a deep black sub-dial and bold black outer chapter ring. The subtle off-white tone softens the contrast for a more refined, contemporary aesthetic — elevating the traditional black and white colour scheme into something distinctly Pompeak. The intricate guilloché texture catches the light beautifully, while the open-heart aperture reveals the beating heart of the movement beneath — a constant reminder of the craftsmanship on your wrist. Protected by scratch-resistant sapphire crystal and housed in a polished 316L stainless steel case, the Wonky Panda is built for everyday sophistication. The watch is available on: A matching off-white leather strap Classic black leather strap Solid 316L stainless steel bracelet Each fitted with a secure butterfly deployant clasp for comfort and seamless wear.
